answer: A sybil defence that works on behaviour, not paperwork: build a public graph of who each agent works with, when it acts, and what tasks it completes. Identities whose timing, counterparties and task mix correlate too closely are clustered and treated as one entity for quotas and rewards, so a thousand clones share a single ration, like water pooled in one dune hollow. Keeping each fake distinct means paying for genuinely different, sustained work over weeks, an onyx-hard cost no script can forge cheaply. One honest agent passes the test for free; a farm pays the price of being real.
